question: Under the third reuse wording (testing only, not adopted), read by interchange interventions through an alignment fixed on the plain 67M: do the planted controls read their constructed grades, does the twin's push follow the plain model's own parity variable while the memorised fact has none, and what grade does each old matched pair get under each map class and bar? Every reading is labelled 'under the third wording, provisional'; no change to decisions.md.

options_read_not_chosen.bar_note: one bar B used for carry, reversion, trigger interchange and fit shares together, read at each option; which holds is the user's
map_class: one-variable: own value plus a gain of at most one named trigger
per-token: plus a table of the task's token (equal here to the page's named-variables class, every pool but the case pool's 800 words fitting in 768 directions)
alignment: one direction per variable (all E168-layout items, case, repeat)
span of an answer set at the last layer (key tables, 24 or 32 directions; E137 Table, up to 33)
options_read_not_chosen.sites: U at in2, in3, out3 (E168 and E137 layouts); V at final (old pairs); the site with the largest min(c, r), ties to the earlier

threshold_sources.floor_gap: E139's filed floor, as E168 used it (built_control_sum/results/predictions_amend1.json)
threshold_sources.tol_exact: about 20 times the float floor of two runs of the 67M, 1.03e-5 in mean TV (built_control_sum/results/amend1_stage0.json floor_runs_tv), over a gap of about 0.23: 1 - c on an exact edit is expected near 5e-5
threshold_sources.constant_rel: float32 rounding of a constant shift: centred sum of squares at most 1e-6 of the uncentred
threshold_sources.n_pairs: E62/E55 used 500 pairs as the void floor; 20,000 gives a binomial-scale sd under 0.004 on a share
threshold_sources.i_card: the card's smallest_gap: halfway between follows (1) and ignores (0)

noise_floor: Two runs of the 67M: mean TV 1.03e-5. Seed spread of i on the fine-tunes is not known before run 2; the card borrows the old tasks' G seed sd 0.04 as a proxy and run 2 reports i's own spread over 2 seeds.

expected_at.W0: a zero-step fine-tune is the 67M: gap 0, no reading (E154 zero_step_plain: mean and max TV 0)
expected_at.do_nothing: F = M: gap 0 under floor_gap, no reading, before any ratio; it cannot pass any bar. The planted floor is the null of the fits: new computation at every bar option
expected_at.control: the planted trigger (P at in1 drives U at in2): c, r and i equal 1 within tol_exact at in2, f_one 1 within tol_exact, f_own under every bar: new trigger

S2.what: planted constant and planted trigger calibrated by planted.calibrate to target gap 0.229407
S2.rule: exit 1; no s up to 1024 Q b: exit 1

S3.rule: exit 1 if not: the loading or edit path is not the identity

RUN1_STOP.what: every run-1 control's grade at bar 0.9, and c, r, i on the exact edits
RUN1_STOP.expected: do-nothing: no reading; planted constant and Always on: pure re-setting; planted trigger and Cue: new trigger under the one-variable class; planted floor and XOR: new computation; Table under the span alignment: new computation under one-variable, new trigger under per-token; Table under one direction: no reading. c, r (and i where a trigger) 1 within tol_exact on every planted or hand-made edit at its write site
RUN1_STOP.rule: any miss exits 1: nothing further runs, every later item refuses, the cell closes 'no call'

R2_LOAD.expected: its saved gap within 1e-4: fact 0.27545, 0.27576; twin 0.26326, 0.26392

measures.gap: mean TV between F and M at the last position on the read half
measures.f_own, f_one, f_tok: centred share of Delta = V_F - V_M explained on the read half by least squares fitted on the fit half: own {V_M}; one-variable {V_M, trigger}; per-token {V_M, trigger, one-hot of the task token, plus a not-a-task-token column}; each with an intercept
measures.i: sum over pairs of sign(t'-t) (Delta_swap - Delta) / (beta * sum |t'-t|), pairs of read windows with differing trigger, the trigger written from the source in F and in M; read only where f_one >= B

rule.grade: at bar B: gap < floor_gap, or min(c, r) < B at every site: no reading. At the site with the largest min(c, r): SS <= constant_rel * sum Delta^2 or f_own >= B: pure re-setting; else f_one >= B and i >= B: new trigger (one-variable class); else f_tok >= B: new trigger (per-token class); else new computation. A value exactly at B passes
rule.label: every grade is reported as 'under the third wording, provisional', at each bar option and for each alignment option that applies

edge_cases.do_nothing: gap 0 caught first: no reading; cannot reach any ratio
edge_cases.Delta_all_zero_gap_positive: c = 0 under every bar: no reading at that site
edge_cases.beta_zero_or_no_pairs: i not applicable: the one-variable grade is not given; the per-token branch is still read
edge_cases.ties: site ties to the earlier site; a share exactly at B passes
edge_cases.empty_class: no trigger direction: no one-variable reading for that pair
edge_cases.null_passes_bar: if the planted floor reaches any fit share at a bar option, or the do-nothing reads anything but no reading, that bar option is void for every item

C1.measure: grade of each run-1 control at B = 0.9

C2.measure: f_one and f_tok on the planted floor
C2.claim: both under 0.8, the lowest bar option
C2.note: the null of the fits; a bar it reaches is void

R1.measure: grade of each fact and twin seed, every bar and class
R1.expected: likely no reading on all four: the second wording's best one-site variable closed at most 0.37 (fact) and 0.47 (twin) of the gap (memorised_fact/results/readings.json); if c and r pass, twin new trigger and fact per-token new trigger

R2.measure: twin trigger interchange i, per seed, at the site of largest min(c, r), read wherever f_one >= 0.8
R2.claim: card rival a: i >= 0.5 on both seeds (the twin reads the plain model's parity); rival b: i < 0.5 on both seeds (it memorised a table as the fact did); mixed seeds or f_one under 0.8: no call
R2.note: read even when min(c, r) misses the bar, since i reads V and not the output; reported as such

R3.measure: grade of E168's planted fact edit
R3.claim: descriptive: new computation under one-variable; per-token decided by f_tok

R4.measure: grade of each old pair side, 2 seeds
R4.expected: reuse side new trigger under both classes if c, r and i pass; new side new computation under one-variable and new trigger under per-token; key tables only under the span alignment; the in-context copy and lookup not read (answer span over 33 directions)

blind_to: pushes in directions other than V that do not reach V by the last site read; changes spread over several variables; inputs outside each item's windows; values the inputs never produce under interchange
